findings.reason: Cut produce (cabbage) is stored completely uncovered on the lower shelf.
Running water was not demonstrated from the tap, and the sink contains used cookware.
Trash bin lacks a fitted lid and is only lined with an open plastic bag.
Pan on the stove contains leftover food residue and cooking oil, and the cutting board surface has noticeable stains.
Dry goods and spices are kept elevated off the floor on a countertop rack in sealed, closed jars.

liveness.observed: Person placed 4 fingers flat onto the surface of the gas stove

continuousTake.detail: The video is a single, continuous camera movement showing the refrigerator, sink, bin, countertop, and stove without visible cuts or edits.

sameKitchenAsReference.detail: The domestic kitchen layout, patterned wall tiles, stainless steel sink, countertop, spice rack, and stocked refrigerator align with the reference description.

activityMatchesOrders.detail: The kitchen displays active operational signs corresponding to recent order fulfillment, including a pan with residue and spatula on the stove, cutting board with knife, utensil in the sink, and a stocked refrigerator.

propsSuspected.detail: Utensils, produce, spices, and appliances appear naturally used and integrated into an everyday home/cloud kitchen setting without signs of staging.

integrity.kitchenSummary: A domestic cloud kitchen featuring a stocked single-door refrigerator, a stainless steel sink with washing supplies, a lined dustbin, a three-burner gas stove with a pan and spatula, a cutting board, a spice rack, and a mixer grinder.

en: Cover cut vegetables like cabbage tightly and store them safely above raw meats in clean, sealed containers.
Clear used cookware out of the handwash sink and keep it free for washing hands; briefly run the tap during checks to show water flow.
Clean the stovetop pans and scrub stained cutting boards between uses to keep preparation areas fresh.
Equip kitchen trash bins with tight-fitting lids and keep them closed throughout service.
During reviews, show a quick video of running tap water to clearly confirm proper handwashing access.
hi: कटी हुई सब्जियों जैसे पत्तागोभी को हमेशा ढककर रखें और उन्हें कच्चे मांस से अलग, साफ डिब्बों में सुरक्षित रखें।
हाथ धोने वाले सिंक से इस्तेमाल किए गए बर्तनों को हटा दें ताकि हाथ आसानी से धोए जा सकें; जांच के समय नल चलाकर दिखाएं।
तवे, कड़ाही और दाग लगे कटिंग बोर्ड को काम के बाद अच्छी तरह साफ करें ताकि खाना पकाने की जगह स्वच्छ रहे।
कचरे के डिब्बे पर ठीक से बैठने वाला ढक्कन लगाएं और उसे हमेशा बंद रखें।
अगली जांच के दौरान नल से पानी बहता हुआ स्पष्ट रूप से दिखाएं ताकि हाथ धोने की सुविधा की पुष्टि हो सके।
or: କଟା ପନିପରିବା ଯେପରିକି ବନ୍ଧାକୋବିକୁ ସର୍ବଦା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ କଞ୍ଚା ମାଂସଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା ସଫା ପାତ୍ରରେ ସାଇତି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
ହାତ ଧୋଇବା ସିଙ୍କରୁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ବାସନକୁସନ ହଟାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ହାତ ଧୋଇବା ପାଇଁ ସଫା ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ଯାଞ୍ଚ ସମୟରେ ନଳ ଚଳାଇ ପାଣି ଦେଖାନ୍ତୁ।
ଚୁଲାରେ ଥିବା କଡ଼େଇ ଏବଂ ଦାଗ ଲାଗିଥିବା ପନିପରିବା କଟା ବୋର୍ଡକୁ ଭଲଭାବେ ସଫା କରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
ଅଳିଆ ପକାଇବା ଡବାରେ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ଢାଙ୍କୁଣୀ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଏହାକୁ ସବୁବେଳେ ବନ୍ଦ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ସମୟରେ ନଳରୁ ପାଣି ଆସୁଥିବାର ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭିଡିଓ ଦେଖାନ୍ତୁ ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା ସୁବିଧା ସହଜରେ ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ହୋଇପାରିବ।
